Name: SignLock
Author: Malenyaaa
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Signs show whatever item you click them with, so it's easy to overwrite one by accident, for example when it sits right next to a chest you open all the time. With this mod, a sign that already shows an item ignores clicks. Hold Shift while clicking to change it on purpose.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]The code for this mod was written with help from an AI. Idea and in-game testing are mine.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
1. Install the latest version of SMAPI.
2. Download this mod and unzip it into your Mods folder.
3. Run the game using SMAPI.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
- Signs that already show an item can't be overwritten by accident.
- Hold Shift to change the item on purpose. The key can be changed, controller buttons work too.
- A short hint above the toolbar tells you when a click was blocked (can be turned off).
- Empty signs work like before, and you can still pick signs up with a tool.
- Settings via Generic Mod Config Menu or config.json: Enabled, UnlockKey, ShowHint.
- Works in multiplayer. Each player only needs it if they want the lock for themselves.
- Translations: English, German.
- Open source (MIT): https://github.com/Malenyaaa/sign-lock

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]- SMAPI (required): https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400
- Generic Mod Config Menu (optional): https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to Pathoschild for SMAPI.[/color]
